content.user_title: Organize Files and Clean Up Folders
content.value_statement: Cluttered folders make files hard to find and duplicates waste storage. This skill reviews directories, proposes a structure, and organizes files after approval.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a target directory and summarizes files, folders, sizes, and file types.
Groups files by type, purpose, date, activity, or archive status.
Finds exact duplicates and similar file names when requested.
Builds an organization plan before creating folders or moving files.
Creates folders, moves files, and renames files after user approval.
Provides a completion summary and maintenance tips.
limitations: It needs access to the target directory to inspect files.
It should not delete files without explicit user confirmation.
Duplicate detection uses exact hashes or names, not visual similarity.
Large directories may need staged review to avoid mistakes.

use_cases.title: Clean a Downloads Folder
use_cases.description: Sort recent downloads by file type, purpose, and age while keeping uncertain files for review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Project Archive
use_cases.description: Separate active work from completed files and build a clear archive structure before storage.

use_cases.title: Reduce Duplicate Storage
use_cases.description: Find duplicate groups, compare paths and dates, and choose which copies should remain.

prompt_templates.title: Organize My Downloads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cleanup for a common folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me organize my Downloads folder. Ask about scope, files to avoid, and cleanup level before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Find Duplicate Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this directory for duplicate files: [path]. Show duplicate groups with sizes and dates, then recommend which copies to keep.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate reorganization for mixed project files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project folder: [path]. Propose a cleaner folder structure based on file purpose, age, and active work.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Controlled Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with approvals and recovery notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step cleanup plan for [path]. Include a change log, conflict handling, and approval checkpoints before file changes.

output: A summary of file counts, sizes, and common types.
A proposed folder structure for documents, images, archives, and review items.
A request for approval before any files are moved.

output_examples.input: Find duplicates in Documents before archiving.
output_examples.output: The skill lists duplicate groups with paths, sizes, and dates. It recommends one copy to keep and asks for deletion approval.
The skill separates active notes, final deliverables, source files, and archive material into a reviewable plan.

best_practices: Start with one folder and review the proposed plan before changes.
Create a backup or archive copy before moving many files.
Keep a change log so moved files can be found again.
anti_patterns: Running cleanup across an entire home folder without exclusions.
Deleting duplicates before checking paths, dates, and file sizes.
Renaming active project files without checking references or build scripts.

faq.question: Does this skill delete files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It instructs the agent to ask for confirmation before deleting any file.

faq.question: Can it organize only one folder?
faq.answer: Yes. A single target folder is the safest starting point for most cleanup tasks.

faq.question: How does it find duplicates?
faq.answer: It can compare exact file hashes, file names, sizes, and paths when duplicate review is requested.

faq.question: Can it preserve important folders?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks which files or folders should be avoided before analysis begins.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I do before a large cleanup?
faq.answer: Review the plan, create a backup, and approve changes in smaller groups.
